_comment: The artifact view-link shape the hosted MCP server is tested against. Read by tests/Feature/McpContractTest.php (App\Services\Artifacts\ArtifactViewLink) so the field name and which link a tier gets cannot drift. Every permanent artifact — public included — gets the app's short link (`app_open_route`). Anonymous free-tool KV previews are not addressed by this contract; the free tool returns the Worker's URL directly (RUB-452).
